common_intent_requirements.text: 沿平整地面自然走几步
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 沿平整地面自然走几步
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: an adult wearing flat-soled shoes on a level floor. The head, body and both feet stay within the frame, with stationary floor texture providing a clear reference. The adult walks several natural steps across the visible space at an ordinary pace.
Keep the feet readable as they lift, swing and meet the floor.
The body's forward travel follows the stepping action rather than prolonged sliding on both soles.

physics_checks.criterion: 步行呈现可辨识的支撑与摆腿交替，身体移动与脚步相容。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 静态地面纹理对照下，支撑和抬脚落脚阶段可见。
fail_examples: 双脚一直贴地向前滑而身体作走路摆动
脚穿入地面后继续行走
not_required: 不要求每帧精确零滑移
允许自然脚跟脚尖滚动

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
